annotations.bnjettag.io/active-deadline: pod 14400 s from pod start = 1800 s header + per phase (K x 21 x A10 s/run-epoch E 28 / A07 44 x 2.5 + 15 s x K + 900 s), rounded up to 600 s; Job 36000 s from creation (Pending counts) = the 21600 s [D6] window + the pod bound, a backstop
annotations.bnjettag.io/cpu-pin-anti-affinity: required pod anti-affinity on bnjettag.io/gpu-bench-pinned per node: two pinned benchmark pods on one node would pin the same first CPUs of a shared pool
annotations.bnjettag.io/expected-runtime: compute 1.17 h at the A10 aggregate cost (E 28 / A07 44 s per run-epoch), 1.63 h at the A10 per-process 140 s per epoch; 2.13 h at the larger bound with the 1800 s header allowance; arithmetic, not a measurement. STUDY Amendment 1 (B5): a phase under 40 % mean GPU utilization is a finding, not an exclusion
annotations.bnjettag.io/gpu-fingerprint: kai-chang0926-fp-e9511d1aeb sha256 e9511d1aeb39c7c8: chang0926-a-n64-s1 initial_ebops == 11559681 before any arm, else exit 9 (Delta REGRESSION_TICKET); a mismatch on a new product is a finding
annotations.bnjettag.io/gpu-product: NVIDIA-RTX-A6000 via nvidia.com/rtxa6000 (49140 MiB, node label nvidia.com/gpu.memory)
annotations.bnjettag.io/job-shape: klow: the K_low Job of NVIDIA-RTX-A6000 (pod 8 CPU / 32Gi); sibling Job kai-gpubench-rtx-a6000-krule; STUDY Amendment 1 (A2, B6)
annotations.bnjettag.io/k-caps: E: K_rule 10, K_run 9, K_low 4 (capped by node cap 9 (2 CPU + 8 Gi per arm, node reserve 2 CPU / 16 Gi; largest schedulable node 20 CPU / 251.5 Gi)); A07: K_rule 5, K_run 5, K_low 2 (no cap binds)
annotations.bnjettag.io/k-rule: K_rule = floor(0.9 x 49140 / per-process MiB), per-process E 4350 / A07 8446 (A10, TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH, nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps: E 4,350 MiB (K=5 pod, c5805), A07 8,446 MiB (K=3 pods, gpu-16 and gpu-17); campaigns/2026-09-26-training-batch/RUN.md "Takeover check, 2026-09-29T02:47-03:10Z"); K_low = A10 K of the class (E 4, A07 2), or K_run - 1 where K_run <= it (STUDY.md [D2])
annotations.bnjettag.io/narrow-pool: one product on purpose: the controlled timing comparison the setup doc (Pool policy) allows; decisions.md 2026-09-29; ends when the benchmark Jobs are deleted
annotations.bnjettag.io/node-survey: node_survey_20260929T073945Z.json (read 2026-09-29T07:39:45Z): 5 schedulable of 8 nodes; 5 can hold this pod by allocatable
annotations.bnjettag.io/not-practical-after: 6 h after kubectl apply of this Job with no Running pod: delete this Job only (its sibling is judged on its own shape) and keep the PodScheduled message (STUDY [D6], rule 3, Amendment 1 B6); cluster-ops
annotations.bnjettag.io/per-arm-resources: 2 CPU and 8Gi per arm: the pod requests them for its largest K (4), and every phase's K arms are pinned to exactly 2 x K CPUs, the first 2K of the pod's allowed set (bench_driver --cpus; thread env as pilot-b). STUDY rule 5: a phase whose steady cgroup cores / K exceed 2.1 is above budget and kept out of T
annotations.bnjettag.io/retries: backoffLimit 0 and no podFailurePolicy: never re-run automatically (a preempted pod fails the Job)
annotations.bnjettag.io/telemetry-only: GPU-product throughput benchmark, campaigns/2026-09-29-gpu-benchmark; nothing it writes is a result
annotations.bnjettag.io/wandb: disabled: no secret mounted, WANDB_MODE=disabled, bench_driver calls ablation.run_training(remote=False)

args:
set -euo pipefail
BR=/data/chang-n64-20260926/gpu-bench/rtx-a6000-klow
echo "BENCH_POD ${POD_NAME:-na} product NVIDIA-RTX-A6000 slug rtx-a6000-klow shape klow $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo "HOSTNAME_NODE ${NODE_NAME:-na}"
if [ -e "$BR/samples.csv" ] || compgen -G "$BR/p[0-9]*" > /dev/null; then echo "BENCH_ROOT_NOT_EMPTY $BR: move it aside (never delete), then re-apply"; exit 11; fi
mkdir -p "$BR"
exec > >(tee -a "$BR/pod-${POD_NAME:-pod}.log") 2>&1
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '42abed4b5d2e3e9197d36a5031754cfde342fc7b0d03f7bb0106ce16c2e258c0  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT="$BR" BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/chang0926
unset BNJ_STAGE WANDB_PROJECT WANDB_ENTITY WANDB_API_KEY WANDB_TAGS
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
export BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB=8192 BNJ_RSS_GATE_WINDOW=5:105
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-training.txt
NVLIBS=$(python -c "import glob; print(':'.join(sorted(glob.glob('/usr/local/lib/python*/site-packages/nvidia/*/lib'))))")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$NVLIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "041f981a9d5b8c3a7affb175d82de0ca2df9bc6261a172f67cb365c88b4bbd42" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
python -c "import tensorflow as tf; assert tf.config.list_physical_devices('GPU'); print('GPU_GATE_PASS')"
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "CACHE_NOT_READY"; exit 1; }
echo CACHE_READY
echo "GPU_INFO $(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv,noheader || echo na)"
echo "CPU_MODEL $(grep -m1 '^model name' /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d: -f2- | sed 's/^ *//')"
echo "CPU_COUNTS node_logical $(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo) allowed $(nproc) cpus_allowed_list $(grep Cpus_allowed_list /proc/self/status | cut -f2) cgroup_cpu_max $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null || echo na)"
(lscpu 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -E '^(Model name|Socket|Core|Thread|CPU\(s\)|On-line|CPU max MHz|CPU MHz|NUMA node\(s\))' | sed 's/^/LSCPU /' || true
echo "HOST_MEM $(grep MemTotal /proc/meminfo | tr -s ' ') cgroup_memory_max $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || echo na)"
df -h /data
echo "PIP_FREEZE_SHA256 $(python -m pip freeze --all | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
echo 'e9511d1aeb39c7c8e48cc7dbc148ac623f3b2d9844d108da38f1ecfa2bdff1f1  /cmfp/fingerprint_check.py' | sha256sum -c -
FP=0
python -u /cmfp/fingerprint_check.py --run chang0926-a-n64-s1 --expect 11559681 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 --campaign-dir /work/code/campaigns/chang0926 --env-report || FP=$?
if [ "$FP" != 0 ]; then echo "FINGERPRINT_GATE_FAIL exit=$FP node=${NODE_NAME:-na}; no arm started"; exit "$FP"; fi
echo '5ede0778f716cb9299ca82c64547fb993c93d775572d33463a0fef4cbf676c45  /cmbench/bench_driver.py' | sha256sum -c -
exec python -u /cmbench/bench_driver.py pod --bench-root "$BR" --plan-json "$BENCH_PLAN"
